name: Ozutani Tengen
source:
A self-proclaimed jack-of-all-trades operating under his own Nakano detective agency; 37 years old.

Ozutani, aka Oz, is aware that he’s rather old-fashioned. Still, he chooses not to wear the ever-prevalent BMI—Brain Machine Interface—himself.

What he lacks in energy, Oz makes up for with his superb investigation and negotiation prowess, and his vast knowledge of the occult, urban legends, and conspiracy theories. He established the Tengen Ozutani Detective Agency years prior, all on his own.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
